europe_now.title: Italy cuts air traffic in half amid data transmission issue
europe_now.summary: Italy reduced its air traffic capacity by half due to a data transmission issue affecting operations. The disruption prompted immediate response measures within the country's transportation network.

sources.headline: Italy cuts air traffic in half amid data transmission issue

top_stories.title: Franco-German Agreement on Industrial Policy
top_stories.summary: France and Germany reached a formal agreement concerning vehicle emissions standards and regional manufacturing initiatives. Leaders from both countries confirmed the deal during recent bilateral discussions.

sources.headline: France, Germany strike bargain on Made in Europe, car emissions

top_stories.title: European Union Migration Policy Developments
top_stories.summary: Multiple member states have confirmed their backing for proposals allowing national borders to be temporarily closed and asylum procedures to be frozen. Meanwhile, Poland decided to drop a controversial legislative proposal regarding assistance to irregular migrants following public pushback.
